observed_original_abi.decompiler_attribution: Ghidra prints __fastcall for 0x007c3ba0 because it assigns the single incoming local param_1 to ECX; the persisted and derived ABI projections both say thiscall, and the listing (bare RET, no stack argument, ESI-only save) rules out a genuine fastcall stack argument, so the machine-derived thiscall verdict is followed.
abi_derived_abstained_because: flow_not_modelled: the linear ESP walk ends at -4, so the listing is not one path

MOV dword ptr [ESI + 0x170],0x0 at 0x007c3bf9 (unconditional on the +0x170 non-null path, after the 0x00f47410 call returns)
receiver_reads: MOV EAX,dword ptr [ESI + 0x158] at 0x007c3bcd (re-read, argument to 0x00f47380)

accesses: zeroed at 0x007c3bc3 (only on the identity-match path)
read-modify-write at 0x007c3bb5 (OR 0x2, only on the identity-match path)

control_flow: 0x007c3ba0..0x007c3bab: save ESI, alias the ECX receiver, load receiver+0x158, TEST/JZ to 0x007c3be6 when the word is zero.
0x007c3bad..0x007c3bb3: compare the global word at 0x016f6dac with receiver+0x158; JNZ 0x007c3bcd skips the three global writes.
0x007c3bb5..0x007c3bc3: identity-match block sets bit 0x2 in 0x016f8a38, bit 0x8 in 0x016f9110, and clears 0x016f6dac.
0x007c3bcd..0x007c3bdc: re-read receiver+0x158, push it, call 0x00f47380, pop the argument with ADD ESP,0x4, then clear receiver+0x158.
0x007c3be6..0x007c3bee: load receiver+0x170, TEST/JZ to 0x007c3c07 when the word is zero.
0x007c3bf0..0x007c3bf9: push receiver+0x170, call 0x00f47410, pop the argument with ADD ESP,0x4, then clear receiver+0x170.
0x007c3c03..0x007c3c06: MOV AL,0x1; POP ESI; RET (the +0x170 word was non-null).
0x007c3c07..0x007c3c0a: XOR AL,AL; POP ESI; RET (the +0x170 word was zero).

Straight-line two-phase body: the +0x158 phase always runs first and the +0x170 phase always runs second; neither phase is guarded by anything other than its own null test. There is no loop, no switch, no indirect branch and no early return before the two POP ESI/RET tails.
null_behaviour: receiver+0x158 == 0: JZ 0x007c3be6 skips the identity compare, both OR writes, the clear of 0x016f6dac, the call to 0x00f47380 and the clear of receiver+0x158; all three globals are untouched.
receiver+0x158 != 0 and != 0x016f6dac: JNZ 0x007c3bcd skips only the three global writes; the call and the field clear still happen.
receiver+0x158 != 0 and == 0x016f6dac: both flag words are OR-ed and 0x016f6dac is zeroed before the release call.
receiver+0x170 == 0: JZ 0x007c3c07 skips the call to 0x00f47410, the clear of receiver+0x170 and the MOV AL,0x1, and the function returns 0.
receiver+0x170 != 0: 0x00f47410 runs, receiver+0x170 is cleared and the function returns 1.
mechanics.byte_width_return: Both exits write only AL (MOV AL,0x1 / XOR AL,AL) and neither clears the upper three EAX bytes, so the upper EAX bytes at the RET are residue from the last callee that ran on that path (0x00f47380 and/or 0x00f47410). The return is a 1-byte value, not a 4-byte int.

mechanics.virtual_dispatch: None. abi_derived reports indirect_calls 0, vtable_shaped_loads 0, call_offsets []; categories.vtables is MISSING and ghidra_function.vtables lists no vtable references. The only transfers of control are two direct CALLs.
mechanics.frame_and_saves: PUSH ESI at 0x007c3ba0 is the sole callee-save and is restored by POP ESI on both exits; there is no PUSH EBP, no SUB ESP and no stack locals.

return_semantics.consistency: The same std::uint8_t type is used in the header declaration, the definition, and the model test's static_assert; the test asserts the literal return values 0u and 1u.

implementation.receiver_model: The receiver is forward-declared and opaque in the header. The definition completes it in the .cpp with exactly the two displacements the listing shows: field_158 at +0x158 and field_170 at +0x170, with unnamed padding before and between them. No other field is named.
implementation.port_surface: EditorTeardownPorts{ release_field_158, release_field_170 }, both void(*)(std::uint32_t), installed through editor_teardown_set_ports and cleared by editor_teardown_reset_ports. The defaults are inert so no callee body is fabricated.
implementation.global_model: Three extern dword globals named g_editor_slot_007c3ba0_0 (0x016f6dac), g_editor_slot_007c3ba0_1 (0x016f8a38) and g_editor_slot_007c3ba0_2 (0x016f9110). The evidence names none of them, so no role name is asserted.

unresolved_questions: The real names, types and owners of the three data addresses 0x016f6dac, 0x016f8a38 and 0x016f9110 are not in the evidence pack (categories.globals is MISSING), so the reconstruction uses neutral g_editor_slot_007c3ba0_N names and asserts no meaning for them. The identity compare and the two OR bits are reproduced exactly; the semantics of 'identity', of bit 0x2 and of bit 0x8 are unknown.

The concrete type and ownership of the 32-bit word at receiver+0x158 are not established. It is only ever loaded, compared, pushed to 0x00f47380 and zeroed; the decompiler types the call argument as undefined4, so the model keeps it an opaque std::uint32_t rather than asserting a pointer.
The concrete type and ownership of the 32-bit word at receiver+0x170 are likewise not established; it is loaded, tested, pushed to 0x00f47410 and zeroed.

The bodies of 0x00f47380 and 0x00f47410 are not in the evidence pack, so they remain declared cdecl ports with inert defaults rather than reconstructed routines. What they release, and whether the release is refcount-aware, is unknown.
The upper three bytes of EAX at each RET are callee residue and are not determined by this body; only AL is claimed.

The receiver is treated as an opaque this pointer of at least 0x174 bytes because 0x170 is the largest observed displacement (abi_derived.receiver.max_offset 368, written_through 2). Whether the real object is exactly 0x174 bytes or larger is not settled by this body. The persisted SDK type for the receiver is OpaqueWorldViewer* / cViewer, but the evidence pack for this target carries no structure confirming that.

Subsystem attribution conflicts: the worker assignment says Editors (cEditor teardown neighbourhood, with Editors::cEditor::Dispose among the callers) while the persisted triage record and the briefing both say Terrain. The evidence does not settle it.

The decompiler prints __fastcall with a single ECX-assigned parameter while the derived and persisted ABI both say thiscall; the listing is followed, but the decompiler's own convention for this function was never corrected in Ghidra, so any downstream tool reading Ghidra's signature for 0x007c3ba0 will still see __fastcall.
No runtime trace of the original exists (categories.runtime MISSING), so every behavioural claim here is static-evidence only.

runtime_gate.reason: No original-process trace exists in this repository; the release callees, the identity global and the two flag words are all live engine state that only a run can confirm.
conditions: A Wine trace of a differential scenario that exercises 0x007c3ba0 must record, at a minimum, the 0x007c3bd4 and 0x007c3bf1 call sites with their pushed argument values.

The trace must show at least one invocation where the word at receiver+0x158 is non-null and equal to the word at 0x016f6dac, so that the OR 0x2 / OR 0x8 / clear sequence is observed rather than merely inferred.
The trace must show at least one invocation where the word at receiver+0x170 is non-null, so the AL=1 exit is observed.
The trace must confirm the return register is consumed byte-wide by at least one caller, which is what would justify keeping std::uint8_t rather than promoting the return to a 4-byte int.

The identity and ownership of 0x016f6dac, 0x016f8a38 and 0x016f9110 must be resolved against a loaded-engine observation before the neutral g_editor_slot_007c3ba0_N names can be replaced by real ones.
The bodies reached through 0x00f47380 and 0x00f47410 must be captured before the inert port defaults can be replaced by real routines.
